BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the RosDriver declaration preserves the pinned simulation's primary actuator surface (ten unitree_legged_msgs/MotorCmd publications to the UnitreeJointController 'command' topics) and the /gazebo/model_states observation used by CheatIO, but the stock helper cannot declare an acknowledged stop for [...]

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the pinned ROS 1 stack drives the ten joint controllers only through unacknowledged unitree_legged_msgs/MotorCmd topic publications, UnitreeJointController::stopping is empty, BRAKE is just another MotorCmd mode, and the clone offers no stop, pause or reset service, so the stock e-stop fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED and G8 SAFE-028 with the latch held (HELPER_MISSING, the simulator precedent); every endpoint, the MotorCmd field set (MotorCmd.msg), the /hector_gazebo namespace and the R2 risk were checked against the pin. Defects: the twenty velocity and torque limits were accepted with UNSOURCED_LIMIT_GATE_WARNINGs (the clone shows no negative number), and the velocity bound was a unit error: the xacro's velocity_max reaches the URDF velocity attribute unconverted and the controller clamps dq (rad/s) to it (joint_controller.cpp:149-150, 216-220), so 21 is 21 rad/s, not 21 deg/s; five xacro facts stated those units, and other facts named the anonymous node as 'hector_control', added 'so ...' and absence clauses, or described the SIGINT handler loosely. The reviewer made velocity and torque Limit.operator_required, rewrote ten facts (including leg.xacro's, which now says velocity and effort pass unconverted) and added four (the controller's clamp functions, the 1 kHz FSM loop, the paused launch default, the vendored joint controller's MPL-2.0 notice), and added three fidelity gaps (hector_ctrl competes on the same ten topics at 1 kHz, the unit correction, reads silent and commands delayed 2 s while Gazebo is paused) (driver.py); added illustrative velocity and torque entries for all ten joints (site-limits.example.json); updated facts.md; and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate now fails only G6 and G8 with no G4 warning (stable digest sha256:03cdcaf0db48afbdf0665f804c4f52d810e6ffa78f7259bd4c3359cabdeeefaf; the author's run, with the twenty warnings, had stable digest sha256:fb918daae2afcd20738fd6ac5f24cb53c6aa3dc5204b345d8481bcea7940bca8), the six package cases pass, and collect.py --strict shows no UNSOURCED_LIMIT_GATE_WARNING; RESULT.json's limits note still describes the deg/s bounds and the twenty warnings, which is now stale. For the human reviewer: Simulation only (ROS 1 Gazebo). The ten MotorCmd topics are also published by hector_ctrl at 1 kHz whenever the operator runs it, so MHS commands would be overwritten; the controllers keep applying the last MotorCmd indefinitely (stopping() is empty) and BRAKE is an unacknowledged publication. Gazebo starts paused (biped.launch:7) and the README's pause/reset are GUI actions. Unblocking needs an acknowledged stop the clone names (for example a Gazebo pause service plus a controller hold), or an SDK profile for one. CheatIO::StateCallback reads an uninitialised index when the model is missing (CheatIO.cpp:106-116).

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Repaired from blocked (HELPER_MISSING) to pass under the user's decision of 2026-11-05 (a stop may cite a locally cloned companion repository at a pinned commit). The card now declares two reviewed companions (registry override companion-sources.json): gazebo_ros_pkgs at cd9cc952 (gazebo_ros 2.9.3, ROS 1 Noetic) and gazebo-classic at b22c6e15 (Gazebo 11.15.1), profile ros1-noetic-gazebo11, with version evidence on both sides that gate G1 re-checks (Readme.md:32-34 ROS Noetic, Readme.md:43-44 gazebo-11, hector_control package.xml:10 catkin, biped.launch:15-22 empty_world.launch; gazebo_ros CHANGELOG.rst:5-7 Noetic 2.9.3, gazebo_dev package.xml:23-24 gazebo11). The e-stop is /gazebo/pause_physics (gazebo_ros_api_plugin.cpp:492-498; pausePhysics calls SetPaused(true), 1725-1729), confirmed only by the read-back /gazebo/get_physics_properties with pause == true (383-389; res.pause = IsPaused(), 1489); a failed pause, a failed read-back (a non-ODE engine) or pause false is SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held. The declared re-enable x-cap.drcl-usc.resume.v1 (CORE-086) calls /gazebo/unpause_physics. The ten joint controllers apply torque only inside gazebo_ros_control's world update (gazebo_ros_control_plugin.cpp:196-199, 211-258). The resume does not clear their stored MotorCmds: the controller's only other mode, BRAKE (joint_controller.cpp:158-164), removes the position stiffness and applies damping only, no hold command was found that the package could send (it reads no joint position), and hector_ctrl republishes all ten at 1 kHz; the resumption is disclosed in the resume action, the facts and the gaps (orchestrator condition, SAFE-042). /gazebo/model_states left the device resource (silent while paused) and stays an explicit read; each MotorCmd receipt reports the five values it sent. Safe_state, the facts (now citing both companions), the fidelity gaps and facts.md say that the pause is the paused flag, not a measured standstill, that topic reads go silent while paused, and that the Gazebo GUI, a WorldControl step or any other client can advance or unpause the world. Files: driver.py, fake.py (a paused flag, the three Gazebo services, negative switches), test_driver.py, facts.md, driver.lock.json, reference.json, REFERENCE.md, RESULT.json. All nine gates pass; evidence stays contract_checked on the fake only; no Gazebo, ROS graph or hardware ran; the BRAKE wording follows a claude-sonnet-5-5 review.

The joint controllers keep the last MotorCmd (joint_controller.cpp:33-45) and apply it in update (139-185). BRAKE (158-164) zeros position stiffness and applies damping 20. starting() (117-129) holds the current position, but gazebo_ros_control runs the controller manager only from the world-update hook (gazebo_ros_control_plugin.cpp:196-199, 251), and World::Step skips that hook while paused (World.cc:835-854).
